description: Return one section of a document already open in the RIS document viewer. Intended for the viewer widget, not for direct use — for the full text of a document use `ris_dokument`.

dokumentnummer.description: RIS document number of the open document - from the ris_dokument call that opened it

offset.description: Character offset into the document text; 0 returns the first section and the outline

url.description: Direct URL of the open document, for documents opened by URL rather than by number

name: ris_dokument_abschnitt

dokumentnummer.description: RIS document number of the document this section belongs to

next_offset.description: Offset to request for the following section, or null at the end of the document

outline.description: Jump targets of the document. Only returned for offset 0; empty when the document has no headings

level.description: Heading level 1-6 as marked up in the RIS source

offset.description: Character offset of the heading in the document text

span.description: Characters up to the next heading, or to the end of the text — tells a one-line metadata field from a real section

source_url.description: RIS URL the document text was rendered from

text.description: The requested section of the document text

total_length.description: Length of the complete document text — compare across calls to detect that the document was re-fetched and offsets shifted

title: Dokumentabschnitt
